supersession_reason: The evidence-qualified MIC-only source excludes records lacking an identified E. coli strain or isolate; previous cohort manifests did not pass this frozen evidence requirement.
assay_reference_source: reconstruct assay-linked primary study IDs from validated source records, exact raw DRAMP evidence and DBAASP assay reference numbers using diagnose_mic_baselines.assay_rows

grouping.homology: retain every protocol-mic-01 all-member global-identity edge at or above 0.40
grouping.study_link: connect molecules sharing a primary MIC assay paper identifier
grouping.identifier_alias: treat DOI, PMID, and DBAASP internal article ID in the same declared citation object as aliases; no title-only merging
grouping.method_only_references: not used as a primary MIC study link
grouping.combined_group: transitive connected component of homology and primary-study links

release_gate: Descriptive feasibility audit only. Failed class, homology or primary-study isolation leaves the proposal blocked; no model training or performance reporting is authorized.
